# Pest Heroes

> Pest Heroes is a state-licensed pest control company serving Virginia Beach and the Hampton Roads region of Virginia. Services include termite inspections and treatment, mosquito and tick control, rodent exclusion, crawlspace and moisture work, real estate WDI inspections, move-in treatment, and seasonal pest control. Licensed by the Virginia Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services (VDACS), license #15611.

- Service area: Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Chesapeake, Hampton, Newport News, Portsmouth, Suffolk, Isle of Wight

## Offer

- $29 termite and moisture evaluation, credited toward any treatment.
- Free quotes for all other pests, including ants, rodents, and mosquitoes.

## License

- VDACS pesticide business license #15611. Backed by a written damage claim warranty that is transferable if you sell your home.
